Homework Helper

Three practice games to help with homework: times tables, spelling, and a quiz. Practising a little every day makes homework much easier.

About the donation: Homework Helper is unlocked by a small donation, paid with Federation tokens — tokens are bought on Gumroad, or you can pay with crypto. (In the Federation store, $5 = 1 Token.) How many tokens Homework Helper takes is Roger's decision — he has not set it yet, and there is no payment button on this page. Homework Helper is for kids up to age 16 only. The games below are open so you can see exactly what Homework Helper does.
